name: Polar C-Series Upright Freezer 600Ltr
description: Designed to reliably keep large quantities of foods perfectly frozen, the Polar C-Series freezer is an excellent choice for less demanding professional kitchens. With an impressive 469 litres of usable space, there's plenty of room over the six fixed shelves for all your ingredients - allowing you to maximise the frozen storage capacity of your kitchen.The freezer is easily controlled by a precise digital thermostat, which also displays a constant readout of the internal temperature, so you'll always be able to check the temperature at a glance without opening the unit. The sturdy door is lockable and features a removable seal, adding to the overall security, hygiene and reliability of the freezer. And thanks to the stainless steel construction, the freezer is easy to clean when required.Polar C-Series kitchen refrigeration is designed for everyday commercial use in less demanding environments. Choose C-Series for general storage when you don't plan to access the unit often. The C-series range works in conditions up to 32°C. Suitable for perishable & non-perishable food itemsPlease Note: Not suitable for use in outdoor & mobile environments including catering vehicles.
